description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 992 - Order made to amend the Excise Notification No. 983 published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1945/17 of 15.12.2015 by substitution of Schedule 1 relating to Annual License Fees w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification amends excise license fees and security deposits through a statutory instrument (Excise Notification No. 992) issued under the Excise Ordinance. It contains regulatory changes to licensing requirements and fees, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure matter.
